dedupe_keys.name: drivetrain tower design optimization for the made4wind tension leg platform floating wind turbine in the utsira nord north sea site

description: Vasudev, Gupta and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The archive provides input and result files for a medium-speed geared drivetrain and tubular tower of the MADE4WIND tension-leg floating turbine at Utsira Nord. The description identifies WISDEM-WEIS and OpenMDAO as the computational basis. Although the native resource type is model, the deposited object is explicitly described as design inputs and outputs, so it is catalogued as data. Supporting articles describe the optimisation method; this record does not imply executable solver code is included. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
